result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban arterial with significant vehicle traffic and a lack of visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the immediate intersection. While sidewalks are present, the absence of marked crosswalks and refuge islands on such a wide roadway creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross a high-volume roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane configuration forces pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any mid-point refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, significantly reducing exposure risk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and highway access ramps, creating a high-speed environment that prioritizes vehicle throughput. While sidewalks are present, the lack of visible marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at such a large intersection significantly increases risk for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic plus highway ramps without a refuge island, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Conflict Points
hazards.description: The intersection includes highway on-ramps where vehicles are likely to be accelerating, creating dangerous conflict points with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the road splits toward the highway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness at this wide intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands between travel lanes to reduce exposure time and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, improving visibility.
